title: Glitch Hunt · an evidence-first agent platform
text: Glitch Hunt is a full stack AI playtesting platform. An agent explores a puzzle game, applies the same inputs to two builds, and produces replayable evidence. This edited tour uses actual application recordings with synthetic narration.

title: Public replays · authenticated live operations
text: Each published run has a read only link showing its outcome, model calls, estimated cost, and completed replay. An operator can revoke that link. Launching paid work and changing sharing settings still require authentication.

title: Separate model decisions, execution, and verification
text: The activity trace separates decisions from execution. The model chooses a named landmark. A deterministic navigator applies individual moves, while an independent search verifies completion and route budgets. Observations, request latency, scheduled waiting, and tokens stay visible.

title: Durable coordination across short-lived workers
text: The batch API stores jobs in PostgreSQL before queue dispatch. Private Vercel consumers claim leases, follow shared limits, and save checkpoints. Repair dispatch can republish unfinished jobs. Lease fencing prevents an expired worker from overwriting a newer result.

title: Benchmark history · retain failures and measurement limits
text: Early hosted experiments left many trials unfinished. Checkpoint recovery, clearer tools, and request pacing improved completion. The comparison preserves earlier reports and their different deadlines. Since several settings changed together, these results document progress rather than isolate one cause.

title: Real worker termination · measured checkpoint recovery
text: The recovery drill terminates an actual worker after two saved moves. A replacement resumes and completes the level using three real model calls overall. Duplicate delivery adds no attempt. Cancellation blocks further checkpoints and stale results. The database is local and isolated.

title: Key Management · persistent inventory changes reachable paths
text: Key Management adds persistent inventory to the game state. The agent collects a key, crosses a locked door, reaches the pressure plate, and finishes. A broken key pickup prevents completion. The current catalogue contains thirty six labelled level and update combinations.

title: 60 hosted trials · reliable completion under a shared quota
text: The hosted benchmark completed all sixty trials at one, five, and twenty worker slots. It verified forty five regressions and fifteen healthy cases with zero misses or false alarms. The shared provider quota limits throughput. Explore the public replays and source to inspect the evidence.
